ruleset.name: nitpicker-code-smells-test
ruleset.description: Nitpicker code smell rules for test sources.

rule.message: The string literal {0} is repeated in this file. Name it once as a constant (private static final String NAME) and use the constant. If repeating it is intended, add an exception for pmd/AvoidDuplicateLiterals in nitpicker.config.json.
Remove the unused parameter, or use it. If it must stay, add an exception for pmd/UnusedFormalParameter in nitpicker.config.json.
